recorderAudioCallbackFix.problem: The SDL3 audio callback (run from WebAudio, usually while Asyncify has main suspended) called g_system->getMillis(); with the event recorder recording or replaying, that runs EventRecorder::processMillis(), which updates the fake mixer, runs every timer, and in playback consumes recorded events. A nested suspend from there corrupts the suspended main stack.
